original_record.question:
A monkey has torn off a piece of Captain Jack's map.
<image1>
What does the piece the monkey has torn off look like?
<image2>
original_record.subject: combinatorial geometry

inventory: Main parchment rectangle with irregular upper-right tear; continuous island coastline, skull upper-left, pirate sailing ship lower-left, two small tree/figure marks upper-mid, central six mountains and dashed red route, three stumps/sails below, fish skeleton right, partial lake at tear.

Five torn fragments A ship/mountains rotated, B red X/lake/coast/octopus, C rotated fish skeleton, D trees/mountains/lake, E skull/ship edge. All native outlines/details; parchment gradient normalized to solid pale yellow.
audit.explicit_conditions: Match missing torn map fragment; torn contours, coastline, route and landmark identities must continue after rigid rotation.
audit.display_conditions: Composite packaging headings/separators removed; uniform panel scaling and placement normalized. No solution marks added.

answer_review.reason: Only B supplies the missing upper-right exterior paper corner after a half-turn: its long straight left/bottom borders become right/top, and its concave torn boundary complements the main tear. The lake and dashed route continue across the tear; red X and octopus lie on the missing region. Other fragments have different boundary/coast/landmark arrangements.

source_artifact_exclusions: Blue <imageN> composite headings and separators are dataset packaging, not question content.
artwork_normalization: Parchment photographic gradient replaced with uniform pale-yellow native fill.

Grass hatch marks regularized as native small V strokes; main skull, pirate ship sail/skull, fish ribs and tail, tree/figure group, six mountains, three low stumps/sails, lake, red route and option B red X/octopus retained as native vector strokes.
Torn boundary and common coastline/lake/route on correct B reconstructed with one shared similarity transform; remaining options retain their distinct source landmarks and orientations.
audit.fidelity_review_required: Independent reviewer must compare fine torn-map contour and landmark fidelity, not merely answer B.
audit.stroke_protocol_repair: All visible native strokes normalized to exactly1pt, including grass hatches, landmark detail, red route and red X. No thin-detail exception. Scene coordinates, clipping polygons, option transforms, fills and colors unchanged.

representation_note: The original question/options/answer remain verbatim in original_record and original_question. A Choices block is appended only to expose the unchanged source options in the common answer schema.
branch_mapping_note: Formal branch follows the frozen scene geometry (2D/3D); source_category retains the upstream category.
